question: All the changes in the weather are driven by the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**sun**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The sun is the primary source of energy**.
 
• The energy that the Earth receives from the Sun is the **important cause of our changing weather.**
 
• Solar heat, or heat received by the Earth from the Sun, **warms up vast masses of air**, which are made up of large and small weather systems, as well as the **well-known day-night and summer-winter cycles**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The sun is a massive sphere of heated gases at** extremely high temperatures**, it is the principal source of energy that causes weather variations.
 
• The sun is a very long way away from us. Even so, the sun's energy is so vast that it is the source of all heat and light on Earth.
 
• The earth's surface, seas, and atmosphere** absorb and reflect energy.**
